name: plantao-em-dia
description: SaaS Multi-tenant para gestão de escalas de trabalho e checagens de plantão com Lakebase Postgres (Neon)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
